dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: *sigh* We've had hardly any customers today, there's nothing for me to do.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I always say, if you're looking for a lost person or a cat, why bother coming to us when the Adventurers' Guild exists?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: But standing here doing nothing is mind-numbingly dull!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It looks like you'd rather be working.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I wouldn't go that far! But if I go sneaking off, Nefer'll give me an earful...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, how about you take over for a day and let me get some fresh air? Otherwise, I'm gonna die of boredom...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: *sigh* Alright, it was just a suggestion... I guess I'll get back to "work".

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Come on, Ashru, how about you help me out?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: I knew I couldn't count on you... Alright, alright, go run off and play or whatever.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ashru, did the boss come back just now?

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow~ Meow meow, meow—

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: By the looks of things, she hasn't... Good, good, I made it back in time...

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow meow, meow~

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ashru, did the boss come back just now?

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: (She's back~ You just haven't noticed~)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: By the looks of things, she hasn't... Good, good, I made it back in time...

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: (Human~ Silly~)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I saw Boss Nef sneak into the back room, looking shifty — I think she grabbed something... Could she have been getting some money to pay my wages?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: That must be it! Last time she promised to find me someone who can get a new pair of glasses made. Maybe she's getting ready to buy them for me?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Boss Nef! You really are the bestest, most awesomenest boss ever!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ugh... How does she know literally everything!? I'm done for this time...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I was planning to take a day off and go see Aino. I daren't ask now...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Boss Nef'll be okay, right? I know she wanted me to stay at my post, but...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Screw it! I'll knock off early and go see how she is.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: If she's still not feeling well, I might have to go ask Lauma to have a look at her...
